title: The Lovers to the Hermit: tarot card meanings
description: Tarot card meanings for The Lovers, The Chariot, Strength and The Hermit, upright and reversed, with practical notes for reading them in a spread.

scenes.headline: The Lovers to the Hermit: tarot card meanings
scenes.caption: Four major arcana cards, from The Lovers to The Hermit, with upright meanings, reversals and a tip for each.
scenes.vo: Four major arcana cards, from The Lovers to The Hermit, with upright meanings, reversals and a tip for each.

scenes.headline: The Lovers
scenes.caption: Keywords: choice, values, union, alignment. In the RWS version, two figures stand beneath an angel.
scenes.vo: The Lovers stands for choice, values, union and alignment.

scenes.headline: The Chariot
scenes.caption: Keywords: drive, determination, direction, control.
scenes.vo: The Chariot stands for drive, determination, direction and control.

scenes.headline: Strength
scenes.caption: Keywords: courage, patience, compassion, inner strength. The image shows a woman calmly holding the mouth of a lion.
scenes.vo: Strength stands for courage, patience, compassion and inner strength.

scenes.headline: The Hermit
scenes.caption: Keywords: solitude, reflection, guidance, inner search. A robed figure stands on a height, holding a lantern and staff.
scenes.vo: The Hermit stands for solitude, reflection, guidance and inner search.
